title: Academy FAQ
intro: The Zoo Academy is a premium account feature that allows you to unlock daily gifts and bonuses for your zoo when activated with diamonds. Some perks include reaping extra experience for tending to animals, collecting more coins from shops and admission booths, collecting daily gifts of treasure chest pieces, and even bonuses to various aspects of breeding. When you hit level 10, Madame Yu, the director of the Zoo Academy, will introduce herself and present you the first Mastery quests.
membership_body: There are four membership tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum. As you level up in the Academy, you can unlock the benefits of each tier by purchasing the appropriate membership level. A Bronze membership gives you all unlocked Bronze level benefits. A Silver membership gives you all unlocked Silver and Bronze level benefits. A Gold membership gives you all unlocked Gold, Silver, and Bronze level benefits. A Platinum membership gives all unlocked benefits of Platinum, Gold, Silver, and Bronze levels. However, if you have not unlocked any benefits of a particular tier, you cannot purchase that tier's membership until you unlock at least one scroll in the tier.
stamps_body: When extending a membership you can acquire stamps. 10 stamps will award you 1 VIP Coin. If your subscription expired and you buy a new subscription you will not get stamps! An easy way around that is to buy 1 day bronze and then extend with a subscription that yields stamps. When filling out a stamp card starting from June 19th 2023, you get VIP Coins, allowing you to save them up and pick a reward at a later time. Each subscription tier offers exclusive animal choices. When your stamp card is full, you can redeem an animal from your current subscription level or below.
mastery_body: You can complete regular tasks to earn Mastery Points (depicted as scrolls in quest rewards) towards a Zoo Mastery Level. The initial levels require only a few scrolls, but the amount of scrolls needed to level up increases as you progress. With an activated membership, you also have the option to skip to the next level for diamonds. Progressing to the next level will cost 5 diamonds per uncollected scroll. However, jumping to the next level does not excuse you from completing the remainder of tasks of the skipped level.
tasks_body: Madame Yu will give you tasks every 6 hours. The tasks are to maintain your zoo, like clean enclosures, feed animals, pick up trash, water plants, collect XP pins etc. You should be able to finish the tasks easily by playing the game and doing what you normally would be doing. After completion a timer will appear below Madame Yu counting down until your new set of tasks begins.
tips_intro: A few tips to get the most out of the Zoo Academy:
tip_1: When completing tasks, click on the task bubble on the left side bar if you have trouble locating an item to complete.
tip_2: When purchasing a new subscription, always purchase 1 day of Bronze and then extend to the subscription you actually want. This way you get the biggest discount and stamps. You only get stamps when extending!
tip_3: Although the academy never goes on sale, you can use the Cashback events to get a percentage of diamonds back if you wait until then to load up on academy months. Since the Cashback events are typically 2 months (sometimes 3 months) apart, it's best to stock up so you don't have a lapse. March and November can be key times to stock up on 6+ months by spending 2000 diamonds to get the full 25% of diamonds back.
tip_4: When switching between memberships, the active membership is used as a discount on your upgraded membership. Be sure not to waste diamonds by upgrading to a membership where the full discount cannot be used.
tip_5: Sometimes the game will take a few extra seconds to calculate your new Madame Yu task upon opening the game. Take this opportunity to go directly to your smallest region so that the tasks will calculate based on the smaller zoo instead of your larger main zoo. Alternatively, you can make sure you enter the game a couple minutes before the new task and enter your smallest region before it populates the new task.
